title: The Frozen Hunter
text: A hunter stands frozen mid-stride in a pillar of clear ice, bow drawn, arrow nocked, eyes wide. Whatever she was aiming at, it was behind where you are standing now. Her face is not angry. It is afraid.

options.label: The strongest cuts her free, hoping she can tell you what she saw.

outcomes.text: She thaws, gasping. Before she runs she presses her bow into your hands, and she never looks back.
She thaws, still aiming at what stands behind you.

options.label: Turn round, and look at what she saw.

outcomes.text: You see it just before it sees you.

options.label: Walk on, and do not look back. Whatever she saw, it is still there.

outcomes.text: Not looking back is very hard. Something breathes behind you the whole way.
